other: Final grades are rounded to the nearest whole percentage point.
Generative AI use in coursework is not permitted unless the instructor explicitly authorizes it ahead of time.
Grade disputes go to the instructor in writing no sooner than 7 days after the grade is received, then a meeting; a formal UGA appeal is the next step.
Unit materials are released in batches based on both quiz completion and date.
